blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Aby Maraño, former Philippine women’s volleyball team captain, known for her grit and resilience, has called it a career after 22 years. Maraño announced her retirement on Wednesday. She last played for the Nxled Chameleons in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference. “Actually, retiring wasn’t an overnight decision for me. I had been preparing myself for a long time for the moment when I would have to transition from playing professionally to another chapter of my life,” said Maraño in Filipino, speaking to some reporters. “After 22 years of playing volleyball, I can honestly say that I can still […]...
